checks.command: Re-audit from claimed baseline 46032c69e37af3037af3bf9c7124d0145cff631c: CodeWorkspaceTab completion identity/sync callbacks -> CodeMirrorHost createLspCompletionSource/resolve gate/Tab acceptance -> lspCompletion fetch/resolve/plan/commit -> shared document transaction history
checks.summary: The current production chain freezes workspace, file, URI, language, document revision, provider generation and project-scope identity before asynchronous fetch/resolve. CodeWorkspaceTab force-syncs the live buffer and revalidates the token around provider IPC. CodeMirrorHost mounts the real LSP source and keeps completion, snippet and resolve-gate acceptance local to the editor. lspCompletion validates primary/additional ranges, combines primary edit, imports and parsed snippet text in one dispatch with one history event, and preserves selection-only snippet navigation. Timeout, failure, unavailable, cancelled, stale, policy-change and overlap outcomes remain explicit no-op or explicit-choice paths and do not silently commit old text.

6 files passed; 97/97 tests passed. Coverage includes primary plus additional edits in one dispatch, snippet placeholder mapping and choice cycling, one undo/revision, stale document/provider/policy guards, resolve timeout/failure/null/cancel, explicit retry or primary-only gate, overlap rejection, unavailable capability, mounted completion wiring, and the current sanitized provider trace contract.

Real maven-single provider fixture passed 1/1 on JDK 21.0.4, JDT LS 1.61.0.202607142124.jar and Gradle 8.7. Dependency completion returned org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils with one additional import edit; applying and reverting restored the original document hash exactly. A superseded request was rejected with -32800 while the replacement satisfied, and completion/signatureHelp recovered after provider restart. Current sanitized trace SHA-256: 7c5295e045364bf8f28ca65114cb476c7e1273a8e5e6b0733f78a298a14d745a.
